scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @portfolio/frontend" "npm run dev --workspace @portfolio/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @portfolio/frontend && node scripts/copy-frontend.mjs && npm run build --workspace @portfolio/backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @portfolio/frontend && npm run lint --workspace @portfolio/backend && prettier --check .
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace @portfolio/frontend && npm run lint:fix --workspace @portfolio/backend && prettier --write .
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @portfolio/frontend && npm run test --workspace @portfolio/backend
scripts.test:ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
